section.content: 本发明涉及半导体装置和半导体集成电路。提供种半导体装置，能够迅速稳定用于控制电流源的控制电压。半导体装置包括滤波器电路，该滤波器电路被设置在控制电压产生电路与电流源之间，并且去除控制电压的噪声。所述滤波器电路包括：第电阻元件，其被设置在控制电压产生电路与输出控制电压的输出节点之间；第电容元件，其被设置在输出节点与第电压之间；第二电容元件，其经由第开关元件来被耦合在输出节点与第电压之间。当第开关元件为非导通时，第二电容元件被耦合在第电压与第二电压之间。当第开关元件为导通时，第二电容元件通过输出节点来与第电容元件耦合。

The present invention relates to semiconductor device and semiconductor integrated circuit.A kind of semiconductor device is provided, being capable of control voltage of the immediate stability for control electric current source.Semiconductor device includes filter circuit, and the filter circuit is arranged between control voltage generation circuit and current source, and removes the noise of control voltage.The filter circuit includes：First resistor element, it is arranged between the output node of control voltage generation circuit and output control voltage；First capacity cell, it is arranged between output node and first voltage；Second capacity cell, it is coupling between output node and first voltage via first switching element.When first switching element is non-conduction, the second capacity cell is coupling between first voltage and second voltage.When first switching element is conducting, the second capacity cell is coupled by output node with the first capacity cell.

Semiconductor device and semiconductor integrated circuitThe cross reference of related application

By quoting the Japanese patent application No.2015-247356 submitted on December 18th, 2015 disclosed bag The full content for including specification, accompanying drawing and summary is herein incorporated.

Technical field

This disclosure relates to semiconductor device and the semiconductor integrated circuit with filter circuit.

Background technology

In the prior art, for semiconductor integrated circuit, for general-purpose storage --- for example flash is stored Device --- it is highly desirable to low-power consumption and high speed performance.

Generally, provide various patterns to meet low-power consumption requirement to flash memory etc..For example with such side Method, wherein providing low-power consumption mode and stopping power circuit.

In addition, in order to meet high speed performance, such as needing immediate stability defeated from the power circuit that flash memory includes The voltage gone out.

Thus, Japanese Unexamined Patent Application No.2001-319488 propose a kind of stabilization from biasing circuit export it is inclined The method for putting voltage, to ensure the high speed performance for reading circuit system.

The content of the invention

On the other hand, it is known that the feedback noise from whole semiconductor integrated circuit is appeared in from the inclined of biasing circuit output Put in voltage, and as the counterattacking measure for this problem, using such configuration, wherein (such as inclined to power circuit Circuits) filter circuit for removing noise is provided.

But, the problem of having such, because the capacitive component by filter circuit is influenceed, for defeated from power circuit To take time to be stabilized to desired voltage level for the voltage level gone out.

According to the description of the specification and drawings, other objects and novel features will become obvious.

According to embodiment, semiconductor device includes：Current source；Control voltage generation circuit, it is exported for control electric current The control voltage in source；And filter circuit, it is arranged between control voltage generation circuit and current source, and removes the control The noise of voltage processed.Filter circuit includes：First resistor element, it is arranged on control voltage generation circuit and output control electricity Between the output node of pressure；First capacity cell, it is arranged between output node and first voltage；Second capacity cell, its It is coupled in parallel in the first capacity cell between output node and first voltage；First switching element, it is arranged on the second electric capacity Between element and output node.When first switching element is non-conduction, the second capacity cell is coupling in first voltage and second Between voltage.When first switching element is turned on, the second capacity cell is coupled by output node with the first capacity cell.

, being capable of control voltage of the immediate stability for control electric current source according to embodiment.

As shown in fig. 6, power circuit 24 includes control voltage generation circuit and the filter circuit shared with electric charge 55。

The filter circuit 55 shared with electric charge is arranged between control voltage generation circuit and current source 32, and is removed The noise of control voltage.There is provided the low-pass filter circuit for including resistive element and capacity cell in this example.Based on resistance The resistive component of element and the capacitive component of capacity cell set the cut-off frequency of filter circuit.

The filter circuit 55 that there is electric charge to share being described later on, which is provided with, can share the circuit of electric charge.It can share The circuit of electric charge is operated according to activation signal EAMP.

Control voltage generation circuit exports the control voltage for control electric current source.

Control voltage generation circuit includes operational amplifier (AMP) 50, P channel MOS transistor MOS1 and resistive element R1 and R2.

P channel MOS transistor MOS1 source electrode is coupled to supply voltage VCC, and resistive element R1 is coupled in drain electrode.P ditches Road MOS transistor MOS1 grid receives AMP 50 output signal.

AMP 50 is activated according to activation signal EAMP.In this example, activated according to activation signal EAMP (" H " level) AMP 50, and deactivate AMP 50 according to activation signal EAMP (" L " level).

In standby mode, activation signal EAMP is set to " L " level.In standby mode is read, by activation signal EAMP is set to " H " level.

Resistive element R1 and R2 switching node are fed back to AMP 50 and are coupled to one of input terminal.

AMP 50 other input terminals receive reference voltage V ref input.It is brilliant that the regulations of AMP 50 are output to P-channel MOS Body pipe MOS1 voltage so that the voltage of resistive element R1 and R2 switching node is identical with reference voltage V ref.

The filter circuit 55 shared with electric charge is coupled to AMP 50 output, removes the control electricity exported from AMP 50 The noise component(s) of pressure, is then output to current source 32 by control voltage.

Current source 32 receive from AMP 50 export control voltage, and be adjusted so that and flow through resistive element R1 and R2 electric current identical electric current is flowed.

As shown in fig. 7, with electric charge share filter circuit 55 include resistive element R, capacity cell C1 and C2 and Switch element SW1 and SW2.Capacity cell C1 and C2 and switch element SW1 and SW2 formation electric charge share circuit.

Switch element SW1 includes transmission grid.Specifically, switch element SW1 includes the N-channel of coupling parallel with one another MOS transistor and P channel MOS transistor.Activation signal EAMP is input into the grid of N-channel MOS transistor.Activation signal EAMP inversion signal/EAMP is input into the grid of P channel MOS transistor.Switch element SW2 includes N-channel MOS crystal Pipe.Activation signal EAMP inversion signal/EAMP is input into the grid of N-channel MOS transistor.

Capacity cell C2 is coupling in output node N1 and supply voltage by the switch element SW1 in parallel with capacity cell C1 Between VCC.

Capacity cell C2 is coupling between supply voltage VCC and internal node N2.

Switch element SW1 is arranged between output node N1 and internal node N2, and is set according to activation signal EAMP For conduction/non-conduction state (ON/OFF).

Switch element SW2 is arranged between internal node N2 and ground voltage VSS, and according to the anti-phase of activation signal EAMP Signal/EAMP is set to conduction/non-conduction state (ON/OFF).

Switch element SW2 is complementally operated according to activation signal EAMP inversion signal/EAMP and switch element SW1.When When switch element SW1 is in the conduction state, switch element SW2 is in nonconducting state, and when switch element SW1 is in non-conduction During state, switch element SW2 is in the conduction state.

In standby mode, activation signal EAMP is set to " L " level.In this case, by AMP 50 output It is set to " H " level so that P channel MOS transistor MOS1 is in nonconducting state.Therefore, to resistive element R1 and R2 electricity Stream is turned off.

The filter circuit 55 that description is shared with electric charge below.According to activation signal EAMP (" L " level), switch element SW1 is changed into nonconducting state, and switch element SW2 is changed into conducting state.Therefore, capacity cell C1 is charged to supply voltage VCC。

On the other hand, switch element SW2 is in the conduction state so that capacity cell C2 be coupled to ground voltage VSS and It is charged to ground voltage VSS.

Then, in standby mode is read, activation signal EAMP is set to " H " level.In this case, AMP 50 Be activated and adjust the voltage for being output to P channel MOS transistor MOS1 so that the voltage of resistive element R1 and R2 switching node It is identical with reference voltage V ref.

At the same time, according to activation signal EAMP (" H " level), switch element SW1 is changed into conducting state, and switch element SW2 is changed into nonconducting state.Thus, the operation of electric charge share circuit is started.Capacity cell C1 is coupled with C2 so that charge to electricity Source voltage VCC capacity cell C1 electric charge is shared by the capacity cell C2 that ground voltage VSS is charged to by switch element SW1 And be capacity cell C2 chargings.

As shown in Figure 10, as the relation between the time of startup and current drain, it is necessary to increase current drain to shorten The startup time.That is, being necessarily increased AMP 50 operating voltage to increase current drain.

Based on the present embodiment have the filter circuit 55 that electric charge is shared by the electric charge of electric charge share circuit move come Voltage is adjusted so that control voltage can be adjusted to target voltage rapidly, without increasing current drain.

When switching SW1 conductings, capacity cell C1 and C2 serve as low-pass filter circuit.

The cut-off frequency of filter circuit is set based on capacity cell C1 and C2 and resistive element R1.Therefore, with than Filter circuit 51 compared with circuit is compared, it is not necessary to set the capacity cell of redundancy, and only adds switch element SW1 and SW2, because This can be with the expansion of suppression circuit size.
